summary: Discovers and monitors NDI sources and streams on the network, outputting source rows and callbacks when sources or streams are added, removed, or changed.

key_params.name: callbacks
key_params.note: Callback DAT for NDI source and stream discovery changes

key_params.name: extraips
key_params.note: Additional IP addresses to search when mDNS discovery is insufficient

key_params.name: persistence
key_params.note: Time to keep disappeared sources listed before removing them

key_params.name: customext
key_params.note: Custom editor extension when Extension is set to Custom Extension

key_params.name: extension
key_params.note: Edit/view file extension exposed to external editors

key_params.name: wordwrap
key_params.note: Common DAT node-display word wrap setting

common_gotchas: NDI DAT discovers sources; it does not receive the video or audio stream itself.
mDNS discovery usually works on local networks only; use Extra IPs for routed or non-mDNS machines.
Persistence intentionally delays row removal, so disappeared sources can remain visible briefly.
Callbacks can fire repeatedly on source and stream churn, so generated handlers should be idempotent.
key_concepts: Lists NDI sources discovered on the network.
Extra IPs extends discovery beyond automatic local-network discovery.
Persistence controls how long missing sources remain listed.
Callbacks can react as the discovered source list changes.
